comment: Suppressions, separate from settings.json and from any command line, with a reason per entry.
run.py generates the cppcheck XML suppression file from this; cppcheck's own format has no
field for a reason, so this file is the authority and the generated one is an artefact.
Entry fields: id (cppcheck error id, or * for all), path (repository-relative, glob allowed,
optional), line (optional), symbol (optional), class (why it is suppressible), reason (why
this specific finding is not a defect here), added (ISO date).
false-positive     the analyser is wrong about this code
not-applicable     the finding describes a real property that is not a defect on this target
upstream           the code is vendored and the finding belongs to its upstream, not here
An entry whose class is upstream is a reporting decision, not a safety one: it must never be
used for a memory-safety, injection or crypto-misuse finding, which are evaluated over the
whole compiled surface whatever its provenance.
The list is empty. Nothing has been triaged as suppressible yet, and an entry added to reduce
a finding count without that evidence is the failure this file exists to make visible.
